cards.title: Cross the beach line, turn north
instructions: Approach coordinates a working block with you at check-in
Turn north and parallel the beach line at ½ WTD
Climb to 5,500 ft MSL and accelerate to 240 KIAS
Comply with the area entry procedure
cards.source: Binder, p. 17; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 77.
